name: Gothic Murder -Unmei o Kaeru Adventure-
original_name: ゴシックマーダー -運命を変えるアドベンチャー-
source:
The story is set at the manor of a Count in early 20th century England. The protagonist, a maid at the manor, can foresee the nearby deaths of others in her dreams. And what she foresaw was the death of the Lord she serves. At that time, the manor was also abuzz over inheritance and an ominous will. A dreadful murder plot was moving forward in that manor… To save the life of her Lord, the protagonist scrambles based on the information she receives from her dreams—.

[from [url=https://www.gematsu.com/2020/02/mystery-visual-novel-gothic-murder-unmei-o-kaeru-adventure-coming-to-switch-on-march-12-in-japan]Gematsu[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在20世纪初英国的一位伯爵庄园。主人公是庄园里的一名女仆，她可以在梦中预见到附近其他人的死亡。她所预见的是她所侍奉的主的死亡。当时，庄园里也传出关于遗产和不祥遗嘱的传言。一场可怕的谋杀阴谋正在那个庄园里展开……为了拯救主人的生命，主角根据从梦中得到的信息而陷入困境——。

[来自[url=https://www.gematsu.com/2020/02/mystery-visual-novel-gothic-murder-unmei-o-kaeru-adventure-coming-to-switch-on-march-12-in-japan]Gematsu[/url]]
